caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical ceramic jar with two small, symmetrical handles near the top on either side. The jar is rendered in a pale beige tone with grayish hues, and the interior at the top shows a brownish color. The outside surface of the jar features blue decorative elements: on one side, there are three vertical, stylized tree or plant shapes, and to their right is the figure of a woman wearing a long skirt and bonnet, holding an object that appears to be a mirror or a round item in her right hand. The decorations are stylized and painted in a simple, linear manner. The background of the drawing is plain and light, and the artist’s name, John Tarantino, is written in small letters at the bottom right corner.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
